drums.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. A distorted, overdriven kick drum provides a relentless pulse at 135 BPM in 4/4 time. A resonant, metallic synth sequence runs in sixteenth notes, modulated by a low-pass filter. Gritty, bit-crushed percussion hits and white noise bursts punctuate the off-beats. A dark, growling bass synth follows the kick pattern with slight sidechain compression. High-frequency industrial clangs and mechanical sound effects are processed with short room reverb and delay. The track maintains a dense, saturated texture throughout with minimal melodic variation, focusing on rhythmic intensity and timbral evolution.

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. A distorted, overdriven kick drum drives the rhythm at 130 BPM in 4/4 time. A resonant, acid-style synth bassline plays a repetitive sixteenth-note pattern with frequent filter cutoff modulation. Metallic percussion hits and white noise snares provide rhythmic accents. A high-pitched, dissonant synth lead enters with long, sustained notes processed through heavy delay and bitcrushing. Dark, atmospheric pads with slow LFO-driven panning create a dense background texture. The track features industrial sound effects including mechanical clangs and electrical hums.
